source_title: μ-Bench: an open multilingual transcription benchmark
claim_summary: Sierra open-sourced a subset of its internal ASR evaluation: five locales, five providers, 4,270 human-annotated utterances from 250 real phone conversations at 8 kHz mono, plus a new Utterance Error Rate metric and an open leaderboard
feature: open speech-recognition benchmark and UER metric
availability: public repo sierra-research/mu-bench (created 2026-04-14T17:09Z); code Apache-2.0, data CC BY-NC 4.0 per LICENSE
limitation: Provider rankings are vendor-run; data licence is non-commercial (CC BY-NC 4.0), limiting reuse; GitHub API reports licence NOASSERTION because of the dual licence; dataset download requires a Hugging Face token per repo docs; not executed by us
